marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 30 knots diminishing to southeast 20 this evening
and to light late overnight. Wind light Sunday. Rain changing to periods of drizzle and fog patches Sunday
morning with a risk of freezing drizzle. Temperatures near plus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 to 2 metres subsiding to 1 or less near
midnight.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:

 knots.<br/>
